# RHS PCM & Grants Management Platform

A procure-to-contract system for **Restoring Hope Society (RHS)**, modelled on the Unit4 (Agresso) procurement flow and styled to the *RHS Brand Guideline 2025*.

**Owner:** Bilal Abbassi — all documents generated by the system carry Bilal Abbassi as document owner.

## The process

```
Requisition (PR) → PR approvals → Sourcing (3 quotations) → Purchase order → PO approvals → Contract → Legal → Signatures
                                                                    ↓
                                          Goods receipt → Invoice (3-way match) → Finance approval → Payment → PO closed
```

| Stage | Who | What the interface does |
|---|---|---|
| **Sign-in** | Everyone | Per-account login; role drives navigation and permissions |
| **Requisition** | Requester | Header, justification, priority, needed-by, line items (cost centre / budget line), attachments, predicted approval route |
| **PR approvals** | Dept Manager → Finance → Executive Director (by value band) | Approve / Return / Reject / Delegate with comments, step tracking, notifications |
| **Sourcing** | Procurement Officer | Assign, record quotations (vendor, ref, per-line prices, terms, PDF), side-by-side comparison, weighted score, mandatory **3 quotations** ≥ threshold, award with justification |
| **Purchase order** | Procurement | Auto-drafted from the awarded quotation, branded PO layout, terms, submit for approval |
| **PO approvals** | Procurement Manager → Finance → Executive Director (by value band) | Same decision panel; approved POs are issued to the vendor |
| **Contract** | Procurement → Legal → Signatories | Drafted from the issued PO with the RHS clause library, milestones/payment schedule, legal review loop, RHS + vendor signature, activation |
| **Goods receipt** | Requester / Operations | Receive against PO lines (ordered / received / outstanding), condition, delivery note, photos; partial receipts; PO becomes *partially received* → *received* |
| **Invoices** | Procurement / Finance | Register vendor invoice against a PO, **automatic 3-way match** (PO × receipt × invoice: quantity, price tolerance, cumulative total, duplicates), exception handling with Finance override, approval chain, payment recording; PO auto-closes when fully received and paid |
| **Partnerships** | Partnerships workspace | Partner register (add / remove, stage: identified → due diligence → approved → agreement / MoU → active → closed, or declined) with the projects implemented with each partner clickable from the register, the partner file and the project page. Each partner has a **pre-contract due-diligence file** mirroring the RHS workbook: Scoping (overview + 20-document checklist), Vetting (key personnel, ATC clearance, online presence, audit review, 9-question vetting analysis), Full Partner Capacity Analysis (8 sections, 110 items scored High 3 / Medium 2 / Emerging 1 / N/A with the workbook's section and overall-score formulas), Risk table (likelihood × impact → level from the workbook matrix) and decision. **Vetting only can be shared with the partner**: a link opens a stand-alone form (no sign-in) where the partner confirms its legal identity, lists key personnel, online pages, last audit and self-declarations, signs and submits with a date/time stamp; RHS is notified and the persons / links land in its vetting tables. The whole file exports to Excel in the workbook's layout (`src/data/dueDiligence.ts`, `src/lib/partners.ts`) |
| **HR & Admin** | HR & Admin Officer, line managers, every staff member | **My HR** for everyone: contract start / end (days left), line manager, leave and work-from-home balances (14 + 14 days a year by default, prorated for joiners, editable per person), **check-in / check-out** with the browser location captured (map link, accuracy; time still recorded when location is denied), leave / WFH requests with working-day counting (Fri–Sat weekend), balance and overlap checks, timesheets to acknowledge, payslips to download as PDF. **Staff register** (contracts, line managers, balances, contracts ending within 60 days). **Requests**: line manager approves their reports, HR anyone; staff notified. **Timesheets**: created monthly by the line manager, prefilled from the projects funding the position (salary plan LoE), must total the month's working days, staff acknowledge, HR approves or returns, Excel export. **Attendance** log per day with locations. **Payroll**: Finance runs the month from the master salary plan (social security, income tax, unpaid leave), staff are notified and download their payslip (`src/lib/hr.ts`) |
| **Master salary plan** | Finance Director, HR & Admin | Staff register by **RHS number** (position, department, country, contract, monthly salary; status active / new — to recruit / left). **Salary coverage**: for each staff member the project budget lines that pay the salary (one RHS number per unit, LoE %), the amount and % covered in the year by active projects, pipeline from proposals, the gap, and the covering projects clickable; drill-down lists the lines. **Spending plan**: staff × months of the year from the projects' spending plans (lines without a plan spread evenly), red where a month is not fully covered. Excel export. On the project **Budget** tab every salary line (personnel section / "Person" unit / 26xx account, or marked as salary) must carry a staff RHS number or the **new position** flag before the proposal can be submitted; when the project is **granted**, new positions join the salary plan automatically with an RHS number (one per unit, "to recruit"), the budget lines are linked to them, Finance is notified, and HR records the recruited person with "Fill position" (`src/lib/salary.ts`) |
| **Master budget** | Finance Director + budget holders | Annual organisational running-cost baseline (code `MB-YYYY-NNN`, account no., category, **country**, budget holder, amount). Budget holders fill their own lines while the year is in draft; the Director of Finance & Support approves; a new year can be copied from the last. Every line shows **coverage** by active project budgets (prorated to the year's months), % and number of projects, pipeline from proposals, and the funding gap; click a line to see the covering project lines. Project budget lines carry a master-line reference next to the BL# (`src/lib/master.ts`) |
| **Budgets & BvA** | Finance / Programs | Upload an approved budget (Excel/CSV) — the RHS Project Budget Template (Summary + Direct Cost + Admin Cost) and the Annex 1 donor budget are recognised automatically, other layouts are mapped by column; section headings, sub-totals and the Summary block are read, and sheet sub-totals are reconciled against the lines — save as a project / grant with its budget lines; requisitions pick the project code and budget line from dropdowns; Budget-vs-Actual per line (approved · requested · committed · actual · available · burn %) with Excel export in the RHS BvA layout (Project Budget · BvA with live formulas and monthly forecast columns · Expense Allocation · Commitments); organisation budget and BvA templates stored in the system |
| **Grants (PCM)** | Grants team | Project cycle **under development → submitted → granted → active → closed** with a stage stepper and rules (submission needs a logframe and budget; granting approves the budget for Finance/requisitions, spreads the spending plan and creates the reporting calendar; closing keeps the project in the annual dashboard). Each project carries: proposal sections + files, **logframe** (Annex 2 — exported as Word), **work plan** (sections × activities × weeks grid, exported in the EDC layout), **budget** (RHS template lines, exported with Summary/Direct/Admin/Narrative sheets and formulas), **spending plan** (lines × months), **IPTT** (indicators auto-filled from the logframe at submission, Male/Female/Other per month, exported in the Annex IPTT layout with formulas), **reporting tracker** with reminders, **tasks** (assigned to people, shown on their profile) and **@mention discussion**. Grants tracker with annual view; donor contact list. (`src/lib/grants.ts`) |
| **Tasks** | All | Assigned tasks across projects and colleagues; notifications; "My tasks" page and home card |
| **Country context** | All | Header selector (Amman regional office · Gaza · West Bank · Lebanon · Syria · Sudan · Egypt) filtering master budget lines, projects and the grants tracker; projects carry their countries |
| **Home hub & workspaces** | All | Six department cards — Grants, Partnerships, Procurement, Financial, HR & Admin, Media & Communication — each with live stats and the user's access level; per-user workspace access (none / view / edit / manage) defaults from the role and is overridable in Users & access; routes owned by a workspace are gated; the sidebar switches to the workspace's modules (`src/lib/departments.ts`) |
| **E-Signature** | All | DocuSign-style envelopes: upload PDF/image (SHA-256 fingerprint), recipients with roles (signer / approver / cc) and sequential or parallel order, field tags placed on the page (signature, initials, date signed, name, title, text, checkbox) or auto-placed, adopt-your-signature (draw or type, saved to the profile), statuses sent → viewed → signed/approved/declined → completed, void by sender; the completed PDF burns every field with name · title · date-time (Amman + UTC) · envelope ID · fingerprint under each signature and appends a Certificate of Completion with the audit trail (`src/lib/esign.ts`, files in IndexedDB) |
| **Masters / Admin** | Admin, Procurement, Finance | Vendors register, users & roles, editable approval matrix, organisation settings, full audit trail |

## Run it

```bash
npm install
npm run dev        # http://localhost:5173
npm run build      # production bundle in dist/
```

Sign in with any demo account (password `rhs2025`), e.g. `AlAbbassi.bilal@icloud.com` (administrator). The user menu lets you switch account to walk a document through every role, and reset the demo data.

## Interface: Classic / Modern, home screen, and the sidebar

Two skins ship on the same brand palette. **Classic** is the original interface (navy sidebar, compact cards). **Modern** is a lighter redesign — white sidebar with a brand wash, 16 px cards, tinted canvas, frosted top bar and gradient primary actions. Switch between them under **Settings → Appearance** (admin) or from the account menu (any user); the choice is remembered per device and applies to the login page too. The skin lives in `src/theme/modern.css` as token overrides under `html[data-ui="modern"]`; components keep using the same Tailwind token classes.

Two **home screens**: the original dashboard (greeting, my approvals / tasks / signatures, workspace cards with live figures) and an **app launcher** (search bar, Favorites · Work · Profile rail, large app tiles with the RHS line icons, a faint prosthesis watermark, locked tiles for workspaces the user cannot enter, pending-item badges). Switch from Settings → Appearance, from the account menu, or with the buttons on either home; favourites are per device (`src/pages/Launcher.tsx`).

The sidebar can be hidden to an icon rail (sidebar button, header button or **Ctrl/⌘ + B**) and restored the same way; the state is remembered. The mobile drawer always shows the full menu.

## Branding

Everything visual is driven from **`src/theme/brand.css`** — the only file with literal brand values (RHS green `#00853f`, crimson `#d21e47`, amber `#ffb32c`, navy `#152b38`, Helvetica Neue / Myriad Pro / Helvetica Neue W23). Components consume tokens via Tailwind (`bg-brand-600`, `text-ink-500`, …). Licensed web-font files can be added there with `@font-face`.

## Stack

React 18 · TypeScript · Vite · Tailwind CSS · Zustand (persisted to `localStorage`) · React Router · lucide-react.

State, approvals, numbering and notifications live in `src/store/useStore.ts`; the approval engine (matrix lookup, chain building, decisions, delegation, re-submission) is `src/lib/workflow.ts`; the 3-way match rules are `src/lib/match.ts`; the SOP tier / method engine and sourcing checklist are `src/lib/tiers.ts`. The store is the seam for a real backend: each action maps 1:1 to an API call.

## Project layout

```
src/
  theme/brand.css        brand tokens (single source of truth)
  theme/modern.css       optional 'Modern' interface skin (Settings → Appearance)
  data/dueDiligence.ts   due-diligence template generated from the RHS workbook
  types/                 domain model (PR, PO, Contract, Quotation, ApprovalRule, …)
  data/seed.ts           users, vendors, approval matrix, clause library, sample documents
  lib/workflow.ts        approval engine
  lib/match.ts           3-way match (PO × goods receipt × invoice)
  lib/tiers.ts           SOP §3 thresholds → method, requirements checklist, exception route
  lib/budget.ts          Excel budget extraction (header / column detection) and BvA computation + export
  store/useStore.ts      application state + all workflow actions + audit + notifications
  components/            Layout, Logo, ui primitives, workflow widgets (tracker, chain, decision panel, quotes)
  pages/                 Login, Dashboard, Approvals, requisitions/, sourcing/, orders/, contracts/, receiving/, invoices/, Vendors, admin/, Audit
```
